Must read thread on HMPV: What is HMPV? 🦠

1/ Ever heard of HMPV? 🤔
Human metapneumovirus is a respiratory virus that can cause illnesses ranging from mild colds to severe lung infections. Let’s dive into what you need to know! 🧵 #HMPV https://t.co/823xHj89At

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text:
2/ Who is at risk? While anyone can get HMPV, it’s more dangerous for:
Infants & young children 👶
The elderly 👵
Those with chronic conditions or weak immune systems
People in crowded places or healthcare settings #HMPV

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text:
3/ How does it spread? HMPV spreads through:
Respiratory droplets 💨 (coughing, sneezing)
Touching contaminated surfaces 🖐️
Close contact with an infected person #HMPV

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text:
4/ Symptoms Mild cases:
Runny nose 🤧
Cough 🤒
Sore throat Severe cases:
Wheezing 😮‍💨
Bronchiolitis
Pneumonia
#HMPV

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text:
5/ How to prevent it?
Wash your hands frequently 🧼
Avoid close contact with sick individuals
Disinfect commonly touched surfaces
Cover your mouth when coughing or sneezing 🤲 #HMPV

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text:
6/ Is there a cure? No specific antiviral treatment for HMPV exists yet. Care focuses on symptom relief:
Rest 🛌
Hydration 💧
Fever reducers Severe cases may need hospitalization for oxygen therapy. #HMPV

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text: 7/ Why is it important? HMPV may not be as well-known as RSV or the flu, but it can still cause serious complications, especially in vulnerable groups. Awareness is key! 🛡️ #HMPV

nodes.author: CuriosityHead
nodes.text:
8/ Stay informed and stay safe! 💙If you found this thread helpful, share it to spread awareness. 🙌
#HMPV #HealthTips #RespiratoryHealth #HMPV
